name: coding-toolbox
description: Mechanically enforces the Interaction axis on Stop, blocks content operations on non-UTF-8 files with an encoding hint, and provides fresh-branch, fresh-pr, fresh-work, bump-version and setup-rules skills — the latter installs the golden behavior rules doc (Interaction/Language/Behavior/Mentality) and a tool-routing table as opt-in user-level rules (every project on this machine, also invocable non-interactively via a verbatim argument) — for self-contained git branch, PR/MR, end-to-end work pipeline, semver version-bump and user-level rules setup management.
